body:
## Tool library dialog: merged design and PR order

This comment gives the design for this proposal. It includes the open issues that change the tool and holder data, and an order of pull requests. It contains no code. Comments and corrections are welcome.

Date: 23 Nov 2026. Base: `main` at the date. Source proposal: the body of this issue and its mock-up.

## 1. Intent

Replace the "Tool library" dock tab and the four folded groups of the tool property page with one tool library dialog. It has tools and holders as separate items, a large drawing to scale, and a Recipes tab. Fold in the open issues that change the tool and holder data, so that the dialog and the data work land in an order that does not make us build the same thing twice.

The order of the work follows the code: each step must land before the steps that use it.

## 2. Goals, non-goals, anti-goals

Goals:
- The dialog of #3663: Tools list, tool editor (Tool, Recipes, Details tabs), Holders list and holder view, large drawing.
- One owner for each field (tool, holder, assembly), as #3663 section 4 says.
- Every edit is one undoable command that exists today (`AddTool`, `ChangeTool`, `SetToolBody`, `ApplyCuttingData`). The MCP surface does not change, except where a PR adds a command (then it adds the MCP tool, by the AGENTS.md rule).
- A path for the component model of #2452 (#3642 to #3648) to land under the dialog later, without a second UI.

Non-goals (this design):
- The component model itself (#3642, #3643, #3644, #3646). It keeps its own issues and order.
- Saved operation recipes (#3393). They are a different object (a whole operation). They stay a separate issue.
- Changes to posted output, gouge checks or simulation.

Anti-goals (a failure even if it works):
- A user-holder store or file format that is not the one of #3645. Two formats means a migration later.
- A dialog that a test or MCP flow cannot drive (it must have AccessKit labels, like the other windows).
- A loss of the edit paths of today before the dialog has them (each PR keeps the old surface until its replacement is in).

## 3. What exists today (facts from `main`)

- `Tool` (`crates/tools/src/tools.rs:193-283`): cutter fields, `shank_d`, `shank_len`, `holder_d`, `holder_len` (a cylinder stand-in), `cutting: Vec<CuttingRow>`, `catalog: ToolCatalog`, `outline`, `turning`.
- `ToolDef { tool, number }` (`crates/app/src/schema.rs:265`). `ToolBody` (`schema.rs:285-307`) has `spun`, `library: Option<HolderRef>`, `pieces`. `ToolCutter { spun }` (`schema.rs:321`) holds the drawn cutter.
- `HolderRef { entry, gauge_len, projection }` (`crates/tools/src/holder_library_ref.rs:16`) points at a built-in `HolderEntry` (`holder_library.rs:131`: `taper`, `clamp` ER or Weldon, `gauge_len`). About 55 built-in entries, grouped by taper in `library()`. `fits_shank()` checks the clamping range.
- `SetToolBody::library(world, name, entry, gauge_len, projection)` (`crates/app/src/commands/tool_body.rs:171`) puts a library holder on a tool. `library_body` checks `fits_shank` first.
- UI: the ribbon cell **Tools** (`panes.rs:763`) targets the Tool library page in the dock (`shell.rs:287`, `tool_library.rs`, 140 lines). The tool page is `tool_settings_grid.rs` (Geometry, Holder, Cutting data, Catalog). Holder picker `tool_holder_picker.rs`. Preview `tool_preview.rs` (260 px square). Recipes table `tool_cutting_rows.rs` (324 lines). Assembly pieces `tool_body_assembly_page.rs`.
- Window pattern to copy: the tool shape editor (`pages.rs:479` `tool_shape_editor_window`, opened by `actions.rs:363`, state `state.tool_shape_editor: Option<String>`, test `layout_window_tool_shape`).
- `.camtools` (`crates/app/src/tool_library.rs`): versions 1 to 4, v4 carries `HolderRef`. It drops `ToolCutter`.
- Tests that pin the dock: `layout_page_tool_library`, `layout_page_tool` (`page_layout.rs`, file at 398 lines), and `tool_properties.rs:118-122` ("the library docks instead of opening a window").

## 4. Issues folded in

| Issue | What it adds | Where it goes in this plan |
|---|---|---|
| #3663 | The dialog | UI track, PRs U1 to U6 |
| #3648 | Component browser and assembly builder, in the dock | Retargeted at this dialog: the Holders list and the assembly group are its home. Its scope after #3644/#3645 is U7 |
| #3645 | User component library store (holders included) | The store for "My library" and for user holders. No other store |
| #3642, #3643, #3644, #3646, #3647 | Component model, resolver, document table, indexable mills, MCP | Component track, own order, not changed here |
| #3368 | Taper tip form | Data track D1. The Tool tab shows its fields when it lands |
| #3369 | Form mill and router presets | Data track D2. The Tool tab shows the presets |
| #3662 | `.camtools` cannot carry a form outline, a tapered tip, a single-form thread mill without pitch range; dovetail tolerance | Data track D3, after D1 and D2 |
| #93 leftovers | `.camtools` drops `ToolCutter`; the preview hides a landed `ToolCutter`; `cutter_view` | Export part in D3; preview parts in U3 |
| #808 | Holder flare envelope, stale projection, silent ER fallback | Item 2 in U4. Items 1 and 3 stay in #808 (data, independent) |
| #898 | Vendor, part number, coating, notes | Done on `main` (PR #1070). Shown on the Details tab (U2) |

## 5. Approaches considered

- **A. Dialog first, on the data of today (chosen).** Build the dialog on `ToolDef`, `HolderRef` and `CuttingRow`. The Holders list starts read-only from the built-in library. The component track lands under it later, and "My library" and holder editing plug in when #3645 exists. Cost: the assembly group is built two times (first "holder + stick-out", later the component stack).
- **B. Data first.** Land #3642 to #3645, then the dialog. No rework, but four large `effort:high` PRs come before anything is visible, and that track is another contributor's plan.
- **C. A small user-holder store now.** Dropped: it duplicates #3645 and gives two formats.

Why A: the UI reads tools and holders through few functions (`holder_library::library()`, `HolderRef::resolve`, `ToolDef`). The component model can replace them behind the same calls. The data fixes plug into the Tool tab whenever they land.

## 6. Decisions

Answers to the open questions of #3663:

1. **Dialog or dockable?** A non-modal egui `Window`, like the shape editor. The user can keep it open beside the viewport. (Our call.)
2. **User holders' store:** the store of #3645. Until it exists, holders are read-only.
3. **Recipes:** one `CuttingRow` per work material on the tool, as today. Named shared recipes are #3393 and stay separate.
4. **Assembly editor of #2452:** yes. #3648 is retargeted at this dialog (comment on #3648 and #2452 after approval).
5. **First slice:** U1 below.

Field ownership on the data of today (before components):

| Owner | Fields today | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Tool | `Tool` cutter fields, `shank_d`, `shank_len`, `cutting`, `catalog` | Unchanged |
| Holder | `HolderEntry` (built-in) | Read-only until #3645 |
| Assembly | `ToolBody.library: HolderRef { entry, gauge_len, projection }` | `gauge_len` is the holder's length from the gauge line to its nose face (default: the entry's `gauge_len`). `projection` is the nose face above the tool tip, that is the stick-out. The dialog shows the total gauge length `gauge_len + projection` read-only. The user still types `gauge_len` and `projection`, as in "Apply holder" today, so no edit path is lost |
| Stand-in | `Tool.holder_d`, `Tool.holder_len` | Shown only when the tool has no holder body. Not removed in this design (removal changes the project file) |

Other calls (ours, can change):
- **Edit model:** the dialog keeps the draft-and-Apply model of the tool page today (`tool_settings.rs:118`): edits change a draft, and one Apply is one `ChangeTool`. No command per keystroke or drag. The holder keeps its own Apply (`SetToolBody::library`), as "Apply holder" today.
- **Shank no longer fits the holder:** `ChangeTool` keeps its behaviour on `main` (the builder reads it and does not change it). The assembly group shows the clamping-range check as a warning beside the holder.
- **Stale projection (#808 item 2):** no stored `HolderRef` changes by itself. When the tool lengths change, the dialog seeds the projection field of the holder draft again and marks it as changed, so the user sees it before "Apply holder". Collision output changes only through a user Apply. U4 pins this with a test.
- **Paths that the dialog does not have yet:** the tool property page keeps all its groups until U4 lands. The Tool tab has an "Edit tool shape" button (opens the existing shape window). Modular body pieces (`tool_body_assembly_page.rs`), mesh bodies and the stand-in `holder_d` / `holder_len` go into a folded "Body" section of the assembly group in U4. Only after U4 does the property page become a summary with an "Edit in tool library" button.
- **All tool kinds** use the dialog. Lathe, thread and other kinds keep their kind rows of today (`tool_settings_grid.rs` `kind_rows()`), moved into the Tool tab.
- **Entry points:** the ribbon **Tools** cell opens the window and does not change `ui_target`, so the Properties subject stays (the reason for today's test). It opens on the selected tool when a tool is selected, else on the list. A pick inside the dialog does not change the document selection.
- **Holder key:** U1 to U6 use the entry name (`HolderRef.entry`) as the holder key, for the used-by count too. The change to a component id is U7's work, through the `library_ref` of #3645. Nothing of #3642 to #3645 is on `main` today.
- U1 and U2 can each split in two if their review is too large (list and dialog shell; Tool tab and Details tab).
- The Tools list sources are Document and Catalog in U1. "My library" shows when #3645 lands.
- New UI files are split by area to stay under 400 lines: `tool_library_dialog/` with `list.rs`, `rail.rs`, `tool_tab.rs`, `recipes_tab.rs`, `details_tab.rs`, `holders.rs`, `drawing.rs`, `assembly_group.rs`.
- `page_layout.rs` is at 398 lines and `page_layout_windows.rs` at 331: the new tests go in a new file `page_layout_tool_library.rs` (`layout_window_tool_library`, `layout_window_tool_editor`, `layout_window_holders`).
- The flutes in the drawing are decoration from `flutes` and a helix angle (`catalog.helix_deg`). No geometry law reads them.

## 7. PR order

Each PR is one issue, one branch, a draft PR, gated, reviewed. Sub-issues of #3663 are filed after the design is approved.

UI track (in order; each needs the one before):

| PR | Content | Effort (guess) |
|---|---|---|
| U1 | Dialog shell. Ribbon **Tools** opens the window. Tools list (Document, Catalog) with categories, filter and the row columns of #3663. Add, New, Import, Export move from the dock tab. The dock tab goes. Tests: `layout_window_tool_library`; `tool_properties.rs:118` and `layout_page_tool_library` change to the window | high |
| U2 | Tool editor in the dialog: the list folds into a rail; Tool tab (today's geometry and kind rows), Details tab (catalog facts, #898 fields). Apply = `ChangeTool`. "Edit tool shape" button. The property page keeps its groups | high |
| U3 | Large drawing to scale: cutter, shank, holder body, dimension lines, flute helix lines, toggles. Shows a landed `ToolCutter` (#93 leftover) | medium |
| U4 | Assembly group on the Tool tab: holder link, holder gauge length, stick-out (`projection`), total gauge length read-only, clamping-range check (`fits_shank`), holder picker marks other tapers. Seeds the projection draft again on a tool change (#808 item 2, see section 6). Folded "Body" section with pieces, mesh bodies and the stand-in holder. Uses `SetToolBody::library`. The property page becomes the summary | high (safety floor: holder geometry feeds collision checks) |
| U5 | Recipes tab: the `CuttingRow` table moves here, with surface speed and feed per tooth, the document material mark, Add material, Suggest (`ApplyCuttingData`), Copy from tool (`ChangeTool`) | medium |
| U6 | Holders list (grouped by taper, used-by count, the taper of the mounted machine) and a read-only holder view with "tools that use this holder" | medium |
| U7 | After #3644 and #3645: "My library" source, holder editor writes, an edit to a holder updates its tools in one undo step. This is the retargeted #3648 | high |

Data track (independent of the UI track, in this order because they touch the same `Tool` and `ToolDto` fields):

| PR | Content |
|---|---|
| D1 | #3368 taper tip form |
| D2 | #3369 form mill and presets (stacked on D1 if D1 is still open) |
| D3 | #3662 and the #93 export leftover: `.camtools` carries `ToolCutter`, the tip fields and an optional pitch range; dovetail tolerance |

Component track: #3642 → #3643 → #3644 → #3645 → #3647, #3646. Not reordered by this design. U7 waits for #3644 and #3645.

## 8. Left to the builder

- Exact widget layout inside each tab (follow `crates/ui/AGENTS.md` and the mock-up).
- How the rail and the list share state (`state.rs`).
- Icons for the categories (Tabler set first).
- The exact dimension-line style of the drawing.
